**Acceptance criteria**

**Definition of Done**

- [ ] Design Reviewed
- [ ] Code completed
  - [ ] Code in standard format
  - [ ] All functions and classes documented via docstrings
  - [ ] Code is committed and pushed to its own branch
  - [ ] Code is merged into the main branch through a pull request
- [ ] Tested
  - [ ] Unit tested
  - [ ] Integration tested
  - [ ] 95% code coverage
  - [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] Zero known defects
- [ ] Acceptance tested
- [ ] Live on production servers
